The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that makes `collect` skip any file whose base name matches a pattern, logging each skipped path. It also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md`, adds parser, collection and end-to-end archive tests, and adds a text fixture under `tests/fixtures/`.
